This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2.
Mr. Prasanna Kumar Mohanty, learned counsel enters appearance on behalf of the Opposite Party No.1 by filing a vakalatnama in Court today and the same be kept on record.
Registry is directed to reflect the name of Mr.P.K.Mohanty, as learned counsel for the Opposite Party No.1 in the brief as well as in the cause list.
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the Informant and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State-Opposite Party.
Perused the materials on record.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner by filing the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceeding as well as the order taking cognizance dtd.10.11.2023 in connection with Chauliaganj P.S. Case No.192 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.813 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C.-IV, Cuttack.
5.

Learned counsel for the petitioner at the outset submitted that on the basis of the F.I.R. lodged by the informant on 29.07.2023, a case was registered at Chauliaganj P.S., Cuttack for commission of Rahul Kumar Moda@Rahul vs ) Swarup Ranjan Mohanty ..... ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99215764/
1 offence under Sections 294, 420,506 of IPC.

sentences.text:
He further contended that offence under Section 420,
506 of IPC are compoundable in nature.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that in the meantime the parties are agreed to resolve the dispute amicably and on the basis of the compromise arrived at a intervention of the local gentlemen, well- wishers.
On such ground, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the entire proceeding be quashed.

6. Learned counsel for the Informant on the other hand supported the contention made by learned counsel for the petitioner to the extent that the matter has been settled between the parties on compromise.
He further referred to the affidavit filed by the informant-Opposite Party No.1 before this Court which shall be sworn before the Oath Commissioner of this Court on 07.08.2024.

7. On perusal of the said affidavit it appears that the informant- Opposite Party No.1 submitted that the intervention of the local gentlemen and well-wishers, the matter has been compromised and that the informant does not want to proceed further in the present matter.

8. Learned counsel for the State on the other hand submitted that since the informant is no more interested to continue with the proceeding in view of the affidavit filed, he has no objection if this Court disposes this application.

9. Considering the submissions made by learned counsels appearing for the parties, on a careful examination of the materials on record, further taking note of the affidavit dated 07.08.2024, this Court quashes the offence under Section 294 of IPC.
So far the offence under Section 420, 506 of IPC is concerned, parties are directed to file an application for compoundable offence before the trial court.
In such eventuality, the learned trial court shall pass necessary orders in accordance with law keeping in view the aforesaid observations made by this Court.
10. With the aforesaid observations/ directions, the CRLMC application stands dispose of.

( A.K. Mohapatra) Judge Anil Location: High Court of Orissa Rahul Kumar Moda@Rahul vs ) Swarup Ranjan Mohanty ..... ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99215764/
